this_is_a_post_audit_decision.what_the_audit_showed: the frozen structural head reaches 0.7013 overall accuracy but its bottleneck recall interval is 0.043 to 0.150 and its bottleneck NLL interval is 1.830 to 2.238, which is worse than a uniform three-class guess at 1.099
this_is_a_post_audit_decision.why_this_is_not_a_forbidden_repair: D-219, D-221 and D-222 forbid adding houses, changing the model or retuning thresholds so that the number improves; this decision does none of those. The estimator keeps its exact audited bytes, the audit report is never rerun, and the P08 fragment numbers are untouched. What changes is which construction-time source certifies a route's structural role, and it changes because the audit falsified the premise that a single 90-degree frame can reliably recover a 360-degree topological property for this gate.

root_cause.evidence_in_code: ops/vsmt/vm04_d217_rgbd_worker.py computes structural_label_from_reachable(reachable, position) once per position and appends the same label for all four yaws
root_cause.consequence: at a bottleneck position, frames whose yaw faces a wall may carry no visible passage evidence yet still carry the bottleneck label, so part of the training signal is not identifiable from that single frame
root_cause.cost_of_the_miss: the D-221 prefix extension generated 1664 extra houses to buy bottleneck coverage that this mismatch made unusable as a hard gate
root_cause.what_the_accuracies_do_and_do_not_show: train, calibration and audit agree closely, so there is no material generalization gap in the reported aggregate accuracy; this does not rule out every form of overfitting and does not separate the label mismatch from linear capacity or class imbalance
root_cause.precise_statement: under the frozen feature set, the linear model and the single-frame input contract, scaling the training data did not make bottleneck reliable enough to serve as the P08 hard gate, and the representation has a clear label to visible-evidence mismatch
what_must_not_be_overstated: 0.150 is the upper end of a 95 percent recall interval, not a deterministic ceiling
a low per-frame recall does not by itself prove a route fails, because one route may contain several bottleneck observations; route level yield must be measured by the dry run
more houses being unhelpful is an observation under this frozen contract, not a proof that no additional data could ever help

change.what_p08_qualification_stops_using: the learned structural head probabilities as a gate
change.what_p08_qualification_starts_using: the already frozen D-215 topological rule, evaluated by the data generator at route construction time on the construction-authorized GetReachablePositions graph
change.why_zero: the predicate is not an approximation of the bottleneck definition, it is that definition; D-215 froze every constant it needs
change.required_signature: an ordered basin then bottleneck then basin run along the route, unchanged from D-214

method_basis: the route survey is already authorized to query GetReachablePositions for the two fixed houses while constructing and sealing routes
the resulting graph may certify the planned scenario and support route planning, but is not a deployable observation
permission_boundary.why_this_is_not_cheating: the topology is a data-construction condition shared by every method, not a prediction supplied to a method. It uses no simulator room or object label, and the reachable graph is absent from every deployable input and method cache

scope_reduction_that_must_be_reported.the_paper_may_no_longer_claim: that P08's structural role was publicly inferable from single-frame RGB-D
scope_reduction_that_must_be_reported.the_paper_may_claim: that the fixed P08 route genuinely has a basin bottleneck basin topology, certified by generator-only reachable geometry at construction time
scope_reduction_that_must_be_reported.p08_renamed_to: two basins connected through a topological bottleneck, containing entities

structural_head_disposition.why_not_kept_as_a_shared_feature: identical input bytes guarantee interface parity, not neutral impact: five methods may exploit a noisy input in different ways, so a weak component is not automatically fair. The sunk cost of E-06 is not a reason to carry it.
structural_head_disposition.paper_treatment: the main method describes only the inputs actually used, namely SAM proposals, frozen DINOv2 descriptors, public depth geometry and the causal pose belief; the single-frame structural head may be disclosed in an appendix as a development attempt that was not adopted, and is not presented as a contribution

unchanged.entity_evidence_of_p08: the multi-view stable anonymous fragments that give P08 its unique scientific value never depended on the structural head and are untouched

retired_from_the_p08_gate.note: these two numbers governed a head that no longer gates anything; they are retired from the gate rather than retuned, and they are not replaced by different probability thresholds

anti_tuning.if_p08_still_fails_under_this_predicate: record construction failure and report it; do not weaken the predicate, do not change the route, do not change the house
